subject: GENTLE REMINDER: Global Maritime Logistics Symposium 2026 Submission
body:
[image: Maritime.png]

⏰ *4 HOURS LEFT TO SUBMIT!*

Hopefully you’ve slept and your code is still working 😉.

The submission deadline for the *Global Maritime Logistics Symposium 2026* is *today,
22 September 2026 at 12:00 p.m.*

If you haven’t submitted yet, now’s the time to get everything together and
submit your project through the *submission form
<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfCQhQtxsp6J1vMzayBDNzYIpZD-cN-YD2DB1dUbHPAep0RlA/viewform?usp=header>*
.
📝 Final Submission Checklist

Make sure your submission includes:

   - Team and project details
   - GitHub/GitLab repository with a clear README.md
   - 5-minute pitching video (YouTube Public/Unlisted or Google Drive)
   - Live prototype/demo link
   - Slide deck/documentation

Your project must also:

   - Meaningfully incorporate *AI*
   - Utilize *cloud infrastructure*
   - Have at least a *low-code, semi-working prototype*
   - *Pure no-code submissions are not accepted*

⚠️ Before You Hit Submit

*Test your prototype.* Check that your demo works, your links are
accessible, and your README actually tells the judges how your project
works.

You can *edit your submission anytime before the deadline*, so you can
submit now and make changes later if needed.

And one last thing: your pitching video must *not exceed 5 minutes*.
Exceeding the limit will result in a *1-mark deduction for every additional
30 seconds*.
📚 Need Help?

*👾 *Discord <https://discord.gg/RZ729TdZGf> Head over to #faq or
#create-a-ticket on Discord for any enquiries.

Don't be late! Submit
<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfCQhQtxsp6J1vMzayBDNzYIpZD-cN-YD2DB1dUbHPAep0RlA/viewform?usp=header>
and
hope for the best!


Best Regards,


Aaron Chin

Secretary

*Google Developer Groups on Campus (GDGoC) Maritime Logistics Council*


                       <https://www.instagram.com/maritimelogistics.org/>
